quiesce.cpuBasis: os.cpus() tick counters, 0.2 s window, all logical cores (guard.ts formula)
quiesce.thresholdBasis: foreignCpuBusyPercent (/proc/stat machine busy minus the runner's own processes)

guardTs.basis: guard.ts readQuiesce rule: cpuBusyPercent <= threshold and no process (own or foreign) named on the guard.ts list (/proc names at the end of the window)

quiesce.processListBasis: Linux /proc/<pid>/stat (name, ppid, CPU ticks) at both ends of the window; own = process.pid, given pids and their descendants; exclusion by pid, never by name

portProbe.basis: TCP connect to 127.0.0.1, 400 ms timeout (refused or no answer = closed); the runner's own ports excluded

quiesce.visibility: WSL2 guest: the process list, CPU figures and port probe cover the Linux VM only; Windows processes and Windows load are not visible (D-034: nothing else runs on Windows during a WSL window). In NAT mode the probe does not reach Windows listeners.
